answer: Cash-out clustering: rewards leave the network only by withdrawal to an external address, and each epoch the settlement engine follows every destination a few transfers downstream on public ledgers. Identities whose withdrawals reach the same exchange deposit address are merged and share one reward cap. A farmer splitting into fifty names must keep fifty separate cash-out paths, each needing its own ID-checked exchange account, or the cluster is paid as one. Limits: rewards can sit on a ledge unwithdrawn for months, and mixers plus an ocean of tiny hops blur the signal.
